report:
The study reveals anterior tibial translation, no definite fracture detected.  
 Associated bone bruise/edema at the mild lateral femoral condyle and posterior lateral proximal tibia is noted.   Focal cortical bone depression with thinning articular cartilage at mid lateral femoral condyle( deep lateral notch sign) is detected.  
  
  There is high signal in the ACL; loss of main ACL fiber at the femoral and tibial attachment.  Buckling PCL with intact ligament fiber is observed. 
  
  MCL is intact.  Horizontal tear at meniscal body to the posterior horn with oblique vertical tear at posterior horn involved posterior root of the medial meniscus are detected. 
   
   FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon are preserved. Horizontal tear involved entire of the meniscal body with complex tear at posterior horn involved posterior root of the lateral meniscus, are detected. 
  
   No definite osteochondral lesion is detected.  
  
  The PF joint and joint surface are preserved.   
    Bipartite patellar at superolateral patellar pole is noted.  
    Moderate amount of joint effusion and fluid distended suprapatellar bursa with thickened synovial tissue are seen. 
    Quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.        Complete tear of the ACL ,  
           mild bone contusion at mild lateral femoral condyle and posterior lateral proximal tibia, 
           Evidence of previous osteochondral injury at mid lateral femoral condyle (deep lateral notch sign) 
     Horizontal tear at meniscal body to the posterior horn with oblique vertical tear at posterior horn involved posterior root of the medial meniscus  
     Horizontal tear involved entire of the meniscal body with complex tear at posterior horn involved posterior root of the lateral meniscus, 
       Bipartite patellar at superolateral patellar pole  
       Reactive synovitis with suprapaterallar bursitis

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Sospecha esguince de rodilla.
Hallazgos:
Foco de edema óseo del aspecto posterior del platillo tibial medial.
Signos de rotura completa del tercio proximal / medio del LCA. Se acompaña de traslación tibial
anterior de aproximadamente 9 mm.
Ligamentos cruzado posterior y colaterales continuos. Engrosamiento con alteración de señal del
tercio proximal del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial.
Rotura del menisco medial de rasgo vertical en la periferia del cuerno posterior, en la interfase
meniscocapsular, asociado otro rasgo vertical oblicuo a nivel de la unión de cuerpo - cuerno
posterior.
Rotura vertical periférica en la inserción del ligamento menisco femoral posterior en cuerno
posterior del menisco lateral.
Cartílago femorotibial y patelofemoral de grosor y señal normal, sin defectos condrales profundos.
Tendones regionales de grosor y señal normal.
Moderado / acentuado derrame articular. No se observa quiste poplíteo.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal conservados. Edema de los planos intermusculares.
Impresión:
Rotura completa del LCA. Foco de edema óseo en el aspecto posterior del platillo tibial medial.
Rotura vertical periférica en la interfase meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior del menisco medial
con componente vertical oblicuo en cuerpo-cuerno posterior.
Rotura vertical periférica en cuerno posterior del menisco lateral en sitio inserción del ligamento
menisco femoral posterior.
Moderado / acentuado derrame articular.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia izquierda. Obs. Meniscopatía. Bursitis pata de ganso.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Menisco lateral de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que no
impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía superficial difusa de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura.
Tendón rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Mínimo edema las partes blandas, profundo los tendones de la pata de ganso a la altura del
platillo tibial medial, periférica.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial difusa de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de los tendones de la pata de ganso a la altura del platillo tibial

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn. There are focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.1*1.1 cm), corresponding posterior weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.2*intact5 cm) and non weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about intact5* intact7 cm). There is no subchondral edema.  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is suspected chronic partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. There is tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion. -- Focal high grade chondral defect at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.1*1.1 cm), corresponding posterior weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.2*intact5 cm) and non weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about intact5* intact7 cm), left knee.  
 -- Suspected chronic partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
 -- Some amount of left knee effusion.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Knee pain associated with running.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Minimal lateral patellar tilt, without translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 7 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
No acute osseous, meniscal or ligamentous injury.

Prikazane koštane strukture primjerene su morfologije. Povišeni su intenziteti signala u području
medijalnog kondila femura, medijalnog platoa tibije te dijela tibije u području interkondilarnih
eminencija u smislu koštanog edema. Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Potpuni gubitak hrskavice u području medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba
(hondromalacija IV°), a u lateralnom dijelu su vidljivi izmijenjeni intenziteti signala te redukcija
debljine u smislu hondromalacije III°. Formirani veći rubni osteofiti FT zgloba - uznapredovale OA promjene. Hondormalacija patele II° uz formirane rubne osterofite zglobnih tijela - OA promjene.
Prednji križni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu
mukoidne degeneracije. Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog
kontinuiteta. Ganglion ciste uz dorzalne dijelove oba križna ligamenta.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu degenerativnih
promjena.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga i tijela medijalnog meniska s ekstruzijom cijelog meniska.
Lateralni kolateralni ligamenti je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala te
distendiran.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su izmijenjenih intenziteta signala u području insercije na
pateli u smislu degenerativnih promjena, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.Manja količina izljeva u suprapateralnoj burzi te u dorzalnom dijelu
koljenskog zgloba. Bakerova cista CC promjera do 32 mm.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss with superimposed foci of full-thickness chondral fissuring with subchondral cystic change and marrow edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade chondral fissuring at the inferomedial trochlea and trochlear notch.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Thickening of the medial collateral ligament, likely reflecting scarring from prior injury. No edema to indicate an acute injury.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis with intrasubstance signal alteration at the medial insertion.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 9 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Moderate medial compartment and mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
2. Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.
3. No meniscal tear.

Constatations radiologiques:

Alignement articulaire normal.

Le signal osseux est normal. 

Il n'y a pas d'évidence de chondropathie significative.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur, le ligament collatéral médial et le complexe tendino-ligamentaire latéral sont intacts et sans particularité. 

Il y a une déchirure horizontale oblique du corps du ménisque latéral, s'étendant à la surface tibiale sans fragment déplacé.

Il y a des légers changements dégénératifs de signal dans le corps du ménisque médial sans franche déchirure.

Les tendons extenseurs sont intacts et sans particularité. Un peu d'oedème dans le paquet graisseux supra-patellaire.  Le rétinaculum patellaire et les tendons de la patte d'oie sont normaux

Il n'y a pas d'épanchement articulaire significatif, pas de kyste de Baker.

Conclusion:

Déchirure horizontale oblique non déplacée du corps du ménisque latéral.

Signe de coincement du paquet graisseux supra-patellaire.

Il n'y a pas d'autre anomalie.
